title: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror
description:
Crescent Creek: Survival Horror thrusts you into a remote, abandoned farm filled with secrets and danger. As you navigate its dark corridors and eerie surroundings, you'll face intense survival challenges. Uncover hidden keys, solve intricate puzzles, and piece together the mansion’s dark past. Shadows hide more than just secrets—each choice could be your last.

Features:

• Atmospheric exploration of a sprawling Farm

• Complex puzzles and hidden lore

• Resource management and survival mechanics

• Intense enemy encounters that adapt to your decisions

• Branching paths leading to multiple endings

Do you have what it takes to survive Crescent Creek’s haunting mystery? Dive in, if you dare.
description_short: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror plunges you into a desolate farm, cut off from civilization and steeped in mystery. As you explore its winding corridors and ominous rooms, you’ll need to make critical choices, as each path could lead to salvation or peril.
